messages.content: On the app channel, for user_01, please look up up to five headphones in electronics using the query "headphones," check the latest business news, and find similar alternatives to the Sony WH-1000XM5 for product_id p_sony_xm5_blk. Pick one option for quantity 1, place a hold on it, and confirm the order. Then generate a PayPal invoice to alice@company.com for payment_amount 199.99 using payment_gateway paypal and payment_method card, with invoice_items including product_id prod_12345 and quantity 1. After that, check the current BTC price and my investment account balance. Also get the weather alert for New York, publish a high-priority travel advisory to my app with priority high, and create a high-priority app summary document titled "Purchase and Travel Advisory Summary" covering the purchase, invoice, weather, and portfolio info. Please tag it with shopping, invoice, weather, and portfolio.
